essence: Non-enviousness is the chief cause in the transmission of knowledge.
Therefore kings with heroic steadiness are fit to perform this imperishable royal self-knowledge without expenditure.
Lack of faith in this dharma prevents attainment of me and perpetuates cyclic death and rebirth.
The Lord pervades and supports all beings without being contained or limited by them; their apparent inert form conceals the opposite knowledge-nature.
The Lord both bears and sustains beings without being contained by them, while the ignorant mistake his nature for a limited earthly self.
